maddeler.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic كِتَاب (kitāb)bor.
Classical Persian کتاب (kitāb /ketâb)
Middle Persian 𐭡𐭩𐭲𐭠 (bytʾ /⁠xānag⁠/)
Classical Persian خانه (xāna /xâne)
Classical Persian کِتَابْخَانَه (kitābxāna)bor.
Ottoman Turkish کتابخانه (kitabhane)bor.
Arabic كتابخانة
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish کتابخانه (kitabhane), borrowed from Classical Persian کِتَابْخَانَه (kitābxāna), from کتاب (kitāb /ketâb) + خانه (xāna /xâne, “house”). By surface analysis, كِتَاب (kitāb) + خَانَة (ḵāna).
